checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Exactly three separate square logo images
Each reads Moss & Mile with ampersand
must.why: All spell MOSS & MILE correctly, though image 2 is curved and slightly awkward.
Bike, hills/cyclist badge, and M monogram with leaf and road.
Bike icon, round badge, and monogram are distinct layouts.

must.item: Green and black on plain white, no mockups or labels
must.why: Plain near-white backgrounds, green and black only; no labels or mockups.

faults.what: Image 3 monogram: second M reads as a lowercase 'n' / 'Mn', so it doesn't clearly read M&M; the road and leaf overlap messily.
Image 2 has tiny, sketchy cyclist and uneven brushy edges. Text spacing is a bit uneven. It also adds 'CYCLING CLUB', which was not requested but was described.
Image 3 uses a mid-green and green ampersand; slightly generic and heavy.

summary: Three distinct, correctly spelled green-and-black square logos on white; the first is clean, and the third has a malformed 'M' that looks like 'n'.
